{{Top|leg}}
'''Cybernetic exercise braces''' were a powered [[exoskeleton]] used in patient recovery. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used braces on her lower body while recuperating on the [[Cinnabar Moon]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
